subject: Request: SOC 2 Type II report and secure evidence transfer options
messages:
From: Emily Thompson <emily.thompson@acme-corp.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: security@acme-corp.com
Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 08:12:00 -0800
Subject: SOC 2 Type II report request and how to share artifacts

Hi Markus,

Quick intro: I manage third-party security reviews for Acme Cloud. We're performing our annual supplier assessment and need your latest SOC 2 Type II report covering the period Apr 1, 2025 - Mar 31, 2026 (or the closest audit window you have). Can you confirm availability and the preferred method to receive artifact evidence (SFTP, secure Drive link, or a one-time download)?

Specifically we need:
- The SOC 2 Type II report (PDF) and bridge letter if full period isn’t covered
- A short inventory of controls tested and any subservice organizations used
- Evidence manifest (file list) for encryption, access logs, and change control samples

We typically accept a secure Drive folder (restricted to our security@acme-corp.com) or an SFTP drop. If you use a ticket/hubspot record for transfers, share that reference and any transfer password instructions.

Can you also share an example bridge letter if the report timeframe differs?

Thanks — Emily
Emily Thompson
Senior Vendor Risk Analyst
Acme Cloud

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.inference.com>
To: Emily Thompson <emily.thompson@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.inference.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II report request and how to share artifacts

Hi Emily — thanks for reaching out and for the clear list. Looping in Neha (security lead) and Monica (customer success) so we can coordinate delivery.

Short answers up front:
- We can provide the SOC 2 Type II report PDF (independent auditor cover) and a standard bridge letter when the coverage period needs clarification.
- Preferred transfer methods (in order): 1) Encrypted one-time Share link in our secure Redbox (SaaS secure file share) 2) Customer-managed SFTP (we can push) 3) Encrypted Google Drive folder with access limited to your security@acme-corp.com account.

We avoid sending evidence as email attachments. For large artifact sets we provide a manifest.csv (filename, size, sha256) and a short note on expected folder structure to make ingestion easier.

Action items for you:
- Confirm the audit timeframe you'd like covered (you requested Apr 1, 2025 - Mar 31, 2026). If that’s correct, we’ll validate which auditor period we have on file and issue a bridge letter if needed.
- Tell us your preferred transfer method (Redbox link, SFTP credentials, or Drive). If Redbox is OK we’ll send an invite and a manifest within 48 hours.

I’m attaching: a sample bridge letter, and a short secure-transfer options PDF that outlines our Redbox process and filename conventions.

Neha — can you confirm the items we typically include in the manifest for ACME (logs, change control excerpts, encryption key mgmt snippet)? Monica — FYI for renewal/contract record.

Thanks,
Markus Klein
Enterprise AEs — Redwood Inference
m: +1 (415) 555-0193

Attachments: redwood_bridge_letter_sample.docx (bridge letter template), secure-transfer-options.pdf (transfer methods and manifest sample)

From: Emily Thompson <emily.thompson@acme-corp.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: security@acme-corp.com
Date: Fri, 6 Nov 2026 07:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II report request and how to share artifacts

Thanks Markus — Redbox sounds good. Confirming audit period: Apr 1, 2025 - Mar 31, 2026 is exactly what we need.

We prefer: Redbox one-time invite (security@acme-corp.com). For artifacts please include:
- SOC 2 Type II report (PDF)
- Bridge letter if the auditor report does not exactly match the requested period
- Manifest.csv with sha256 and last-modified for each file
- Samples: 3 access log snippets (include timestamps), 2 change-control tickets, 1 encryption key rotation log entry (redacted), and the latest incident response playbook snapshot used during the period.

If any of these are restricted, flag them in the manifest and provide a short justification. We can take redacted samples as necessary.

We also have a short vendor attestation form — do you want that completed before transfer?

Regards,
Emily

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.inference.com>
To: Emily Thompson <emily.thompson@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.inference.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Sat, 7 Nov 2026 15:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II report request and how to share artifacts

Emily — great, thanks for confirming the window and the item list. We will:

1) Validate the auditor coverage and generate a bridge letter if our report window differs by date.
2) Prepare the manifest.csv (filename, size, sha256, last-modified, redaction-flag).
3) Stage the documents in our Redbox and send an invite to security@acme-corp.com by Mon EOD (Nov 9).

Quick note on redaction and minimal shares (templates you can use when pushing back to downstream teams):
- Minimal package (fast path): SOC 2 PDF + bridge letter + manifest.csv + 1 sample from each category (access log, change control, encryption rotation). This is usually sufficient for low-risk assessments.
- Full package (detailed): SOC 2 PDF + bridge letter + manifest.csv + all requested samples (as you listed) + auditor evidence index. Full package is available on request and may take 3–5 business days to stage.

If you have a vendor attestation form, please send it and we’ll sign and return prior to transfer. Otherwise we’ll send our standard vendor attestation.

For your intake team: suggested one-line reply templates you can use internally when closing the loop
- "Received: Redwood SOC 2 Type II and manifest staged in Redbox; redactions noted; SQA review scheduled."
- "Need additional redaction: request for PI removal from log snippets — Redwood to provide redacted samples by MM/DD."

Neha — I’ll hand the evidence staging to you and Monica for the Redbox invite.

Cheers,
Markus
